decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Site location and block plan; as built second floor plan; as built roof plan; as built elevation 1; as built elevation 2; as built elevation 3; as built general section AA; proposed second floor plan; proposed roof plan; proposed elevation 1; proposed elevation 2; proposed elevation 3; proposed section AA; image of proposed roof extension; imagine of existing as built dormer; Design and Access Statement. 

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - Prior to the commencement of the development, details of all proposed external materials, which shall resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application, in respect of the following, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority: 

a) Manufacturer's specification details of all facing materials.    

b) Photographs of material samples against the existing external materials on site. 

The relevant part of the works shall be carried out in accordance with the details thus approved. 

Reason:  To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Erection of roof extension including installation of two rooflights to the side and rear roof slopes, increase in the size of the roof terrace, and associated works.
